cli.finalMessage:
Built the scheduled payments screen at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using Strata components (`Card`, `Amount`, `Tag`, `Badge`, `Menu`, `Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `EmptyState`, `ToastRegion`) so it themes correctly across brands, schemes and RTL locales.

- Six mock scheduled payments (rent, internet, car loan EMI, fitness membership, insurance, cloud storage) each showing payee, amount, next date and repeat cadence, with one shown paused as a demo.
- Each row has an overflow menu to pause/resume, edit (opens a dialog to change amount, date and frequency), or cancel.
- Cancelling opens a danger-toned confirmation dialog stating the action can't be undone; confirming removes the payment permanently (no undo affordance), with a toast confirming the result.
- A "Schedule a payment" button in the header (and in the empty state, once all payments are gone) opens a dialog to add a new payment.

I wasn't able to run the app per the instructions, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser.
